semantics.behavior: Combinational four-input AND, OR, and XOR gates
semantics.timing: Outputs respond to current input without clock or added latency; original explicitly specifies a combinational circuit
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initial value specified; outputs are gate functions of current input

numeric.and: 1 exactly when all four binary inputs are 1
numeric.xor: 1 when the number of binary 1 inputs is odd
numeric.width: Four single-bit operands and single-bit results

verification.oracle: Original gate definitions, checked using count of asserted input bits
verification.coverage: All 16 binary input combinations and reverse traversal for transitions
verification.sampling: Sample after 1 ns combinational settling following each stimulus
verification.failure: Fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS only after all cases

specification_ambiguities: X/Z input behavior is not explicitly specified; implement standard Verilog four-state gate reductions, while required oracle coverage checks binary gate truth tables.
